data_fields.name: min_open_tasks
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 in the AI copy (also the LLM top-up); 10 in the UI copy

best_idea: A daily bounty board: once a day, drop what is done, sort what is left by priority, and top the board up to a minimum count, so the hub always has a current goal.
decision_why: Take the daily keep-open, sort and top-up order and the highest-priority-is-current rule for a hub bounty board on the server clock, with the minimum as zone data; reject the LLM-judged completion (completion must come from server-verified game events), reject the refresh-on-read side effect, and reject the two-store split.
acceptance: Server test: a board with two open tasks (priority 9 and 4) and one completed; after 86400 s the next refresh keeps the 9 and the 4 (9 first), adds one more so three are open, drops the completed one and stamps the clock; a second refresh within 86400 s changes nothing; completing the dropped task returns false.
